name: @pipeworx/mcp-fdic

tools.name: fdic_search_institutions
tools.description: Search FDIC-insured banks by name. Returns institution name, CERT ID, location, total assets, deposits, net income, ROA, ROE, and report date.

search.description: Bank or institution name to search for (e.g., "Chase", "Wells Fargo")

tools.name: fdic_get_institution
tools.description: Get detailed profile for an FDIC-insured bank (e.g., CERT "5136"). Returns name, location, assets, deposits, and regulatory details.

tools.name: fdic_financials
tools.description: Get quarterly financial metrics for a bank by CERT ID. Returns assets, deposits, net income, interest income, loan losses, ROA, ROE, efficiency ratio.

limit.description: Number of quarterly reports to return (default 8, which is 2 years)

tools.name: fdic_failures
tools.description: Search FDIC bank failures by date range. Returns bank name, location, CERT ID, failure date, acquiring institution, and fund type, reconciled against FDIC's published Failed Bank List with a `data_as_of` date and a `warning` field when FDIC's own search index is lagging.

limit.description: Number of failure records to return (default 20)

start_date.description: Start date filter — MM/DD/YYYY ("01/01/2023"), YYYY-MM-DD, or a bare year ("2023")

end_date.description: End date filter — MM/DD/YYYY ("12/31/2023"), YYYY-MM-DD, or a bare year ("2023")

tools.name: fdic_summary
tools.description: Get aggregate totals for FDIC-insured banks. Omit `date` for the most recent year with published figures; pass a year or report date for a specific one. Defaults to the US national aggregate; pass `state` for one state. Returns total assets, deposits, net income, interest income, institution and office counts, both combined and split by charter class (commercial bank vs savings institution).

date.description: Report date as YYYYMMDD ("20241231"), YYYY-MM-DD, or a bare year ("2024") for annual figures

state.description: Optional full state name (e.g., "California"). Omit for the US national total.

tools.name: fdic_branches
tools.description: List the current branch and office locations of FDIC-insured banks: street address, city, state, ZIP, county, latitude/longitude, main-office flag, service type (full service, limited, etc.), and the date the office was established. Filter by FDIC certificate number (CERT), bank name, state, and/or city. Answers "where are Sturgis Bank & Trust's branches" and "all bank branches in Ottumwa, Iowa". Source: FDIC, BankFind institution locations. Use fdic_search_institutions to find a CERT from a name.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (e.g. "14413" for Iowa State Bank and Trust Company of Fairfield)

name.description: Bank name fragment (e.g. "Sturgis Bank"). Used when cert is not known.

tools.name: fdic_branch_deposits
tools.description: Summary of Deposits (SOD): deposits held at each branch of an FDIC-insured bank as of June 30 of a survey year, in thousands of US dollars, with the branch address, city, state, ZIP, and branch/office identifiers. Pass a cert (and optionally year, state, city); year defaults to the latest survey year published. Returns branches ranked by deposits, plus the sum of the branches returned. Source: FDIC, Summary of Deposits annual branch survey.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (required unless state and city are both given)

year.description: Survey year (June 30 snapshot), e.g. 2024. Omit for the latest published year.

state.description: Two-letter state code of the branch (e.g. "IA")

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fdic forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fdic pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
